definitions.explanation: Comfortable, refreshing sleep. Often used in health and wellness contexts to describe high-quality sleep.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{快眠|かいみん}⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{快眠|かいみん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me some tips for sleeping well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{適度|てきど}→適度：03441_tekido⟧な⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{快眠|かいみん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Moderate exercise is said to lead to better sleep.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in health articles, product marketing (pillows, mattresses), and wellness discussions. Often appears in compound phrases related to sleep improvement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快眠|かいみん}⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧ (sleep aids, sleep products)
- {快眠|かいみん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧ (tips for good sleep)
- {快眠|かいみん}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (methods for sound sleep)
- {快眠|かいみん}まくら (comfort pillow)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{安眠|あんみん}→安眠：12266_anmin⟧: peaceful sleep — similar but often used with ⟦{妨害|ぼうがい}→妨害：07632_bougai⟧ (disturbance)
- ⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧: deep sleep — emphasizes sleeping deeply rather than comfortably
